description: This file defines the BuiltIn class that maps built-in color indices to their RGB values within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for handling XLS files' color data.

classes.name: PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Reader\Xls\Color\BuiltIn
classes.description: A utility class providing a mapping from built-in color indices to RGB hex strings, used during XLS file reading.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Returns an array with the RGB value for a given color index, defaulting to black if not found.
